Distributional alignment in staged alignment.tex: for all integers s,d>=1 and real eta>0 there exist r>=s and one rational probability law on s-subsets of [r], chosen before every label universe and every bounded-list family satisfying separated disjointness, such that an alignment exists with probability at least 1-eta.

definitions.separation: A_I and A_J are disjoint whenever max I < min J
definitions.alignment: one map a:M_* -> B with a(A_I) subset I for every nonempty I subset B
definitions.bad: some appearing label has empty intersection of its occurrence sets inside B

For fixed finite r,s,d, lengths and equality relations on at most d occupied slots per index set form a finite collection of patterns, independent of the label universe, and restriction preserves separation and badness.

If for some xi>0 no finite real sampler works uniformly over allowed patterns, then for every r>=s there is a probability law on allowed patterns such that every s-subset is bad with probability at least xi.

Random finite allowed patterns with a uniform positive lower bound xi on badness yield consistent order-invariant finite laws on all finite rational index sets, hence a countable random separated pattern on Q in which every fixed s-set is bad with probability at least xi.

For a separated countable random slot pattern on Q with law invariant under all increasing automorphisms, almost surely each occupied equivalence class has one rational index common to every set at which it occurs.

On a fixed finite set of sampling outcomes, a real probability law whose expectation of every badness indicator is at most xi<eta can be replaced by one rational probability law whose expectation of every indicator is less than eta, uniformly over all patterns.

claims.natural_statement: For s=3 and r>=3, a sampler uniformly choosing B={1,j,r} over the r-2 middle indices has badness at most min(1,d/(r-2)), uniformly over arbitrary label universes and separated size-d lists. This bound is the finite minimax optimum among all samplers. This restricted theorem does not prove alignment for general s.

For arbitrary r>=3 and any label universe, separated lists on nonempty subsets of [r] of size at most 3 have at most |A_{1,r}| bad triples of the form {1,j,r}. Thus the uniform rational law on these r-2 triples has failure probability at most d/(r-2), and for each d and eta>0 a suitable r can be chosen before the universe and lists. claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset

namespace AlignmentAudit

universe u

def triple (lo mid hi : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := {lo, mid, hi}

def Aligned {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (B : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : M → ℕ, (∀ x, a x ∈ B) ∧
    ∀ I, I.Nonempty → I ⊆ B → ∀ x ∈ A I, a x ∈ I

def RootFor {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (B : Finset ℕ) (x : M) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ B, ∀ I, I.Nonempty → I ⊆ B → x ∈ A I → p ∈ I

def SeparatedOn {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (U : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ I J, I.Nonempty → J.Nonempty → I ⊆ U → J ⊆ U →
    I.card ≤ 3 → J.card ≤ 3 →
    (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ J, i < j) → Disjoint (A I) (A J)

def Witness {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo mid hi : ℕ) (x : M) : Prop :=
  x ∈ A {lo, hi} ∧
    (∃ L, L.Nonempty ∧ L ⊆ {lo, mid} ∧ x ∈ A L) ∧
    (∃ R, R.Nonempty ∧ R ⊆ {mid, hi} ∧ x ∈ A R)

theorem aligned_iff_roots {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (B : Finset ℕ) : Aligned A B ↔ ∀ x, RootFor A B x := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, haB, ha⟩ x
    exact ⟨a x, haB x, fun I hI hIB hx => ha I hI hIB x hx⟩
  · intro h
    let a : M → ℕ := fun x => (h x).choose
    refine ⟨a, fun x => (h x).choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
    intro I hI hIB x hx
    exact (h x).choose_spec.2 I hI hIB hx

theorem avoiding_occurrence {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {B : Finset ℕ} {x : M} (h : ¬ RootFor A B x)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ B) :
    ∃ I, I.Nonempty ∧ I ⊆ B ∧ x ∈ A I ∧ p ∉ I := by
  classical
  by_contra hno
  apply h
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro I hI hIB hx
  by_contra hpI
  exact hno ⟨I, hI, hIB, hx, hpI⟩

theorem card_triple_le (lo mid hi : ℕ) : (triple lo mid hi).card ≤ 3 := by
  have h₁ := Finset.card_insert_le lo ({mid, hi} : Finset ℕ)
  have h₂ := Finset.card_insert_le mid ({hi} : Finset ℕ)
  simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at h₂
  dsimp [triple]
  omega

theorem card_pair_le {I : Finset ℕ} {a b : ℕ}
    (h : I ⊆ {a, b}) : I.card ≤ 3 := by
  have h₁ := Finset.card_le_card h
  have h₂ := Finset.card_insert_le a ({b} : Finset ℕ)
  simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at h₂
  omega

theorem bad_triple_witness {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo mid hi : ℕ} (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi)
    (hBU : triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    (hbad : ¬ Aligned A (triple lo mid hi)) :
    ∃ x, Witness A lo mid hi x := by
  classical
  have hroot : ∃ x, ¬ RootFor A (triple lo mid hi) x := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hbad ((aligned_iff_roots A _).2 h)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hroot
  obtain ⟨I, hIne, hIB, hxI, hmidI⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := mid) (by simp [triple])
  obtain ⟨L, hLne, hLB, hxL, hhiL⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := hi) (by simp [triple])
  obtain ⟨R, hRne, hRB, hxR, hloR⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := lo) (by simp [triple])
  have hIo : I ⊆ {lo, hi} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hIB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact (hmidI (h ▸ hz)).elim
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hLl : L ⊆ {lo, mid} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hLB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hhiL (h ▸ hz)).elim
  have hRr : R ⊆ {mid, hi} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hRB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact (hloR (h ▸ hz)).elim
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hloI : lo ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    have hd := hsep L I hLne hIne (hLB.trans hBU) (hIB.trans hBU)
      (card_pair_le hLl) (card_pair_le hIo) (by
        intro a ha b hb
        have ha' := hLl ha
        have hb' := hIo hb
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha' hb'
        rcases ha' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb' with rfl | rfl
        · exact (hn hb).elim
        · omega
        · exact (hn hb).elim
        · exact hhi)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxL hxI
  have hhiI : hi ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    have hd := hsep I R hIne hRne (hIB.trans hBU) (hRB.trans hBU)
      (card_pair_le hIo) (card_pair_le hRr) (by
        intro a ha b hb
        have ha' := hIo ha
        have hb' := hRr hb
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha' hb'
        rcases ha' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb' with rfl | rfl
        · exact hlo
        · omega
        · exact (hn ha).elim
        · exact (hn ha).elim)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxI hxR
  have hIe : I = {lo, hi} := Finset.Subset.antisymm hIo (by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact hloI
    · exact hhiI)
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ⟨L, hLne, hLl, hxL⟩, ⟨R, hRne, hRr, hxR⟩⟩
  simpa only [hIe] using hxI

theorem witness_middle_unique {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo mid mid' hi : ℕ}
    (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi)
    (hlo' : lo < mid') (hhi' : mid' < hi)
    (hBU : triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    (hB'U : triple lo mid' hi ⊆ U)
    {x : M} (h : Witness A lo mid hi x) (h' : Witness A lo mid' hi x) :
    mid = mid' := by
  classical
  suffices ordered :
      ∀ a b, lo < a → a < b → b < hi →
        triple lo a hi ⊆ U → triple lo b hi ⊆ U →
        Witness A lo a hi x → Witness A lo b hi x → False by
    rcases lt_trichotomy mid mid' with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact (ordered mid mid' hlo hlt hhi' hBU hB'U h h').elim
    · exact heq
    · exact (ordered mid' mid hlo' hgt hhi hB'U hBU h' h).elim
  intro a b hla hab hbh hAU hBU ha hb
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨L, hLne, hLl, hxL⟩, _⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨_, _, ⟨R, hRne, hRr, hxR⟩⟩ := hb
  have hLU : L ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hAU
    have hz' := hLl hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz' ⊢
    tauto
  have hRU : R ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hBU
    have hz' := hRr hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz' ⊢
    tauto
  have hd := hsep L R hLne hRne hLU hRU (card_pair_le hLl) (card_pair_le hRr) (by
    intro l hl r hr
    have hl' := hLl hl
    have hr' := hRr hr
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hl' hr'
    rcases hl' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hr' with rfl | rfl <;> omega)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxL hxR

noncomputable def badMiddles {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact W.filter fun mid => ¬ Aligned A (triple lo mid hi)

theorem card_badMiddles_le {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi ∧ triple lo mid hi ⊆ U) :
    (badMiddles A lo hi W).card ≤ (A {lo, hi}).card := by
  classical
  let S := badMiddles A lo hi W
  have ex : ∀ mid : S, ∃ x, Witness A lo mid hi x := by
    intro mid
    have hm := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid.property
    have hw := hW mid hm.1
    exact bad_triple_witness hsep hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2 hm.2
  choose f hf using ex
  let g : S → ↥(A {lo, hi}) := fun mid => ⟨f mid, (hf mid).1⟩
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro mid mid' heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hm := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid.property
    have hm' := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid'.property
    have hw := hW mid hm.1
    have hw' := hW mid' hm'.1
    have hx : f mid = f mid' := congrArg Subtype.val heq
    have hwm' : Witness A lo mid' hi (f mid) := hx ▸ hf mid'
    exact witness_middle_unique hsep hw.1 hw.2.1 hw'.1 hw'.2.1
      hw.2.2 hw'.2.2 (hf mid) hwm'
  exact Finset.card_le_card_of_injective hg

noncomputable def rationalBadMass {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (badMiddles A lo hi W).card / (W.card : ℚ)

def uniformMass (W : Finset ℕ) (mid : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if mid ∈ W then (W.card : ℚ)⁻¹ else 0

theorem uniformMass_nonneg (W : Finset ℕ) (mid : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ uniformMass W mid := by
  unfold uniformMass
  split_ifs <;> positivity

theorem sum_uniformMass {W : Finset ℕ} (hW : W.Nonempty) :
    ∑ mid ∈ W, uniformMass W mid = 1 := by
  have hc : (W.card : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hW.card_pos.ne'
  simp [uniformMass, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hc]

theorem rationalBadMass_eq_expectation {M : Type u}
    (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) :
    rationalBadMass A lo hi W =
      ∑ mid ∈ W, if Aligned A (triple lo mid hi) then 0 else uniformMass W mid := by
  classical
  symm
  calc
    _ = ∑ mid ∈ badMiddles A lo hi W, (W.card : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [badMiddles, Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro mid hm
      by_cases hg : Aligned A (triple lo mid hi) <;> simp [hg, uniformMass, hm]
    _ = rationalBadMass A lo hi W := by
      simp [rationalBadMass, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]

theorem triple_card {lo mid hi : ℕ} (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi) :
    (triple lo mid hi).card = 3 := by
  have hends : lo < hi := hlo.trans hhi
  simp [triple, ne_of_lt hlo, ne_of_lt hhi, ne_of_lt hends]

theorem triple_injective_on {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi) :
    Set.InjOn (fun mid => triple lo mid hi) W := by
  intro mid hm mid' hm' heq
  have hx : mid ∈ triple lo mid' hi := by rw [← heq]; simp [triple]
  have hbounds := hW mid hm
  simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
  rcases hx with h | h | h
  · omega
  · exact h
  · omega

theorem rationalBadMass_le {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ} (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi ∧ triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : (A {lo, hi}).card ≤ d) :
    rationalBadMass A lo hi W ≤ (d : ℚ) / W.card := by
  have hc : (badMiddles A lo hi W).card ≤ d := (card_badMiddles_le hsep hW).trans hd
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hc) (by positivity)

theorem three_rational_sampler (d : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ (M : Type u) (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M),
        SeparatedOn A (Finset.range (N + 2)) →
        (A {0, N + 1}).card ≤ d →
        ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) < η := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((d : ℝ) / η)
  have hNposR : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hNposR
  refine ⟨N, hNpos, ?_⟩
  intro M A hsep hd
  have hWne : (Finset.Icc 1 N).Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨1, by simp; omega⟩
  have hW : ∀ mid ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      0 < mid ∧ mid < N + 1 ∧ triple 0 mid (N + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (N + 2) := by
    intro mid hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hm
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> omega
  have hb := rationalBadMass_le hsep hWne hW hd
  have hcard : (Finset.Icc 1 N).card = N := by simp
  rw [hcard] at hb
  have hbR : ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      (d : ℝ) / N := by
    have hc : ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
        (((d : ℚ) / (N : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := Rat.cast_le.2 hb
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast] using hc
  apply hbR.trans_lt
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hNposR).2
  have hm := (div_lt_iff₀ hη).1 hN
  nlinarith

end AlignmentAudit

import Mathlib

open Finset
open scoped Classical

namespace AlignmentAudit

universe u

def triple (lo mid hi : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := {lo, mid, hi}

def Aligned {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (B : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : M → ℕ, (∀ x, a x ∈ B) ∧
    ∀ I, I.Nonempty → I ⊆ B → ∀ x ∈ A I, a x ∈ I

def RootFor {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (B : Finset ℕ) (x : M) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ B, ∀ I, I.Nonempty → I ⊆ B → x ∈ A I → p ∈ I

def SeparatedOn {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (U : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ I J, I.Nonempty → J.Nonempty → I ⊆ U → J ⊆ U →
    I.card ≤ 3 → J.card ≤ 3 →
    (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ J, i < j) → Disjoint (A I) (A J)

def Witness {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo mid hi : ℕ) (x : M) : Prop :=
  x ∈ A {lo, hi} ∧
    (∃ L, L.Nonempty ∧ L ⊆ {lo, mid} ∧ x ∈ A L) ∧
    (∃ R, R.Nonempty ∧ R ⊆ {mid, hi} ∧ x ∈ A R)

theorem aligned_iff_roots {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (B : Finset ℕ) : Aligned A B ↔ ∀ x, RootFor A B x := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, haB, ha⟩ x
    exact ⟨a x, haB x, fun I hI hIB hx => ha I hI hIB x hx⟩
  · intro h
    let a : M → ℕ := fun x => (h x).choose
    refine ⟨a, fun x => (h x).choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
    intro I hI hIB x hx
    exact (h x).choose_spec.2 I hI hIB hx

theorem avoiding_occurrence {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {B : Finset ℕ} {x : M} (h : ¬ RootFor A B x)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ B) :
    ∃ I, I.Nonempty ∧ I ⊆ B ∧ x ∈ A I ∧ p ∉ I := by
  classical
  by_contra hno
  apply h
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro I hI hIB hx
  by_contra hpI
  exact hno ⟨I, hI, hIB, hx, hpI⟩

theorem card_triple_le (lo mid hi : ℕ) : (triple lo mid hi).card ≤ 3 := by
  have h₁ := Finset.card_insert_le lo ({mid, hi} : Finset ℕ)
  have h₂ := Finset.card_insert_le mid ({hi} : Finset ℕ)
  simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at h₂
  dsimp [triple]
  omega

theorem card_pair_le {I : Finset ℕ} {a b : ℕ}
    (h : I ⊆ {a, b}) : I.card ≤ 3 := by
  have h₁ := Finset.card_le_card h
  have h₂ := Finset.card_insert_le a ({b} : Finset ℕ)
  simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at h₂
  omega

theorem bad_triple_witness {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo mid hi : ℕ} (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi)
    (hBU : triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    (hbad : ¬ Aligned A (triple lo mid hi)) :
    ∃ x, Witness A lo mid hi x := by
  classical
  have hroot : ∃ x, ¬ RootFor A (triple lo mid hi) x := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hbad ((aligned_iff_roots A _).2 h)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hroot
  obtain ⟨I, hIne, hIB, hxI, hmidI⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := mid) (by simp [triple])
  obtain ⟨L, hLne, hLB, hxL, hhiL⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := hi) (by simp [triple])
  obtain ⟨R, hRne, hRB, hxR, hloR⟩ :=
    avoiding_occurrence hx (p := lo) (by simp [triple])
  have hIo : I ⊆ {lo, hi} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hIB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact (hmidI (h ▸ hz)).elim
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hLl : L ⊆ {lo, mid} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hLB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (hhiL (h ▸ hz)).elim
  have hRr : R ⊆ {mid, hi} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB := hRB hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hzB ⊢
    rcases hzB with h | h | h
    · exact (hloR (h ▸ hz)).elim
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hloI : lo ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    have hd := hsep L I hLne hIne (hLB.trans hBU) (hIB.trans hBU)
      (card_pair_le hLl) (card_pair_le hIo) (by
        intro a ha b hb
        have ha' := hLl ha
        have hb' := hIo hb
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha' hb'
        rcases ha' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb' with rfl | rfl
        · exact (hn hb).elim
        · omega
        · exact (hn hb).elim
        · exact hhi)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxL hxI
  have hhiI : hi ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    have hd := hsep I R hIne hRne (hIB.trans hBU) (hRB.trans hBU)
      (card_pair_le hIo) (card_pair_le hRr) (by
        intro a ha b hb
        have ha' := hIo ha
        have hb' := hRr hb
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha' hb'
        rcases ha' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb' with rfl | rfl
        · exact hlo
        · omega
        · exact (hn ha).elim
        · exact (hn ha).elim)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxI hxR
  have hIe : I = {lo, hi} := Finset.Subset.antisymm hIo (by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact hloI
    · exact hhiI)
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ⟨L, hLne, hLl, hxL⟩, ⟨R, hRne, hRr, hxR⟩⟩
  simpa only [hIe] using hxI

theorem witness_middle_unique {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo mid mid' hi : ℕ}
    (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi)
    (hlo' : lo < mid') (hhi' : mid' < hi)
    (hBU : triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    (hB'U : triple lo mid' hi ⊆ U)
    {x : M} (h : Witness A lo mid hi x) (h' : Witness A lo mid' hi x) :
    mid = mid' := by
  classical
  suffices ordered :
      ∀ a b, lo < a → a < b → b < hi →
        triple lo a hi ⊆ U → triple lo b hi ⊆ U →
        Witness A lo a hi x → Witness A lo b hi x → False by
    rcases lt_trichotomy mid mid' with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact (ordered mid mid' hlo hlt hhi' hBU hB'U h h').elim
    · exact heq
    · exact (ordered mid' mid hlo' hgt hhi hB'U hBU h' h).elim
  intro a b hla hab hbh hAU hBU ha hb
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨L, hLne, hLl, hxL⟩, _⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨_, _, ⟨R, hRne, hRr, hxR⟩⟩ := hb
  have hLU : L ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hAU
    have hz' := hLl hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz' ⊢
    tauto
  have hRU : R ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hBU
    have hz' := hRr hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz' ⊢
    tauto
  have hd := hsep L R hLne hRne hLU hRU (card_pair_le hLl) (card_pair_le hRr) (by
    intro l hl r hr
    have hl' := hLl hl
    have hr' := hRr hr
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hl' hr'
    rcases hl' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hr' with rfl | rfl <;> omega)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hxL hxR

noncomputable def badMiddles {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact W.filter fun mid => ¬ Aligned A (triple lo mid hi)

theorem card_badMiddles_le {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi ∧ triple lo mid hi ⊆ U) :
    (badMiddles A lo hi W).card ≤ (A {lo, hi}).card := by
  classical
  let S := badMiddles A lo hi W
  have ex : ∀ mid : S, ∃ x, Witness A lo mid hi x := by
    intro mid
    have hm := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid.property
    have hw := hW mid hm.1
    exact bad_triple_witness hsep hw.1 hw.2.1 hw.2.2 hm.2
  choose f hf using ex
  let g : S → ↥(A {lo, hi}) := fun mid => ⟨f mid, (hf mid).1⟩
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro mid mid' heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hm := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid.property
    have hm' := Finset.mem_filter.mp mid'.property
    have hw := hW mid hm.1
    have hw' := hW mid' hm'.1
    have hx : f mid = f mid' := congrArg Subtype.val heq
    have hwm' : Witness A lo mid' hi (f mid) := hx ▸ hf mid'
    exact witness_middle_unique hsep hw.1 hw.2.1 hw'.1 hw'.2.1
      hw.2.2 hw'.2.2 (hf mid) hwm'
  exact Finset.card_le_card_of_injective hg

noncomputable def rationalBadMass {M : Type u} (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M)
    (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (badMiddles A lo hi W).card / (W.card : ℚ)

def uniformMass (W : Finset ℕ) (mid : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if mid ∈ W then (W.card : ℚ)⁻¹ else 0

theorem uniformMass_nonneg (W : Finset ℕ) (mid : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ uniformMass W mid := by
  unfold uniformMass
  split_ifs <;> positivity

theorem sum_uniformMass {W : Finset ℕ} (hW : W.Nonempty) :
    ∑ mid ∈ W, uniformMass W mid = 1 := by
  have hc : (W.card : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hW.card_pos.ne'
  simp [uniformMass, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hc]

theorem rationalBadMass_eq_expectation {M : Type u}
    (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M) (lo hi : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) :
    rationalBadMass A lo hi W =
      ∑ mid ∈ W, if Aligned A (triple lo mid hi) then 0 else uniformMass W mid := by
  classical
  symm
  calc
    _ = ∑ mid ∈ badMiddles A lo hi W, (W.card : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [badMiddles, Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro mid hm
      by_cases hg : Aligned A (triple lo mid hi) <;> simp [hg, uniformMass, hm]
    _ = rationalBadMass A lo hi W := by
      simp [rationalBadMass, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]

theorem triple_card {lo mid hi : ℕ} (hlo : lo < mid) (hhi : mid < hi) :
    (triple lo mid hi).card = 3 := by
  have hends : lo < hi := hlo.trans hhi
  simp [triple, ne_of_lt hlo, ne_of_lt hhi, ne_of_lt hends]

theorem triple_injective_on {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi) :
    Set.InjOn (fun mid => triple lo mid hi) W := by
  intro mid hm mid' hm' heq
  change triple lo mid hi = triple lo mid' hi at heq
  have hx : mid ∈ triple lo mid' hi := by rw [← heq]; simp [triple]
  have hbounds := hW mid hm
  simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
  rcases hx with h | h | h
  · omega
  · exact h
  · omega

theorem rationalBadMass_le {M : Type u} {A : Finset ℕ → Finset M}
    {U : Finset ℕ} (hsep : SeparatedOn A U)
    {lo hi : ℕ} {W : Finset ℕ} (hWne : W.Nonempty)
    (hW : ∀ mid ∈ W, lo < mid ∧ mid < hi ∧ triple lo mid hi ⊆ U)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : (A {lo, hi}).card ≤ d) :
    rationalBadMass A lo hi W ≤ (d : ℚ) / W.card := by
  have hc : (badMiddles A lo hi W).card ≤ d := (card_badMiddles_le hsep hW).trans hd
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hc) (by positivity)

theorem three_rational_sampler (d : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ (M : Type u) (A : Finset ℕ → Finset M),
        SeparatedOn A (Finset.range (N + 2)) →
        (A {0, N + 1}).card ≤ d →
        ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) < η := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((d : ℝ) / η)
  have hNposR : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hNposR
  refine ⟨N, hNpos, ?_⟩
  intro M A hsep hd
  have hWne : (Finset.Icc 1 N).Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨1, by simp; omega⟩
  have hW : ∀ mid ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      0 < mid ∧ mid < N + 1 ∧ triple 0 mid (N + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (N + 2) := by
    intro mid hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hm
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    simp only [triple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> omega
  have hb := rationalBadMass_le hsep hWne hW hd
  have hcard : (Finset.Icc 1 N).card = N := by simp
  rw [hcard] at hb
  have hbR : ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      (d : ℝ) / N := by
    have hc : ((rationalBadMass A 0 (N + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 N) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
        (((d : ℚ) / (N : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := Rat.cast_le.2 hb
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast] using hc
  apply hbR.trans_lt
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hNposR).2
  have hm := (div_lt_iff₀ hη).1 hN
  nlinarith

end AlignmentAudit

claims.natural_statement: On a fixed finite set of sampling outcomes, a real probability law whose expectation of every badness indicator is at most xi<eta can be replaced by one rational probability law whose expectation of every indicator is less than eta, uniformly over all patterns.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset

namespace AlignmentRationalization

universe u

theorem rational_below {x δ : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x - q < δ := by
  by_cases hzero : x = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hzero, hδ]⟩
  · have hpos : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hlow : max 0 (x - δ) < x := by
      rw [max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨hpos, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqlo, hqhi⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hlow
    refine ⟨q, (le_max_left _ _).trans hqlo.le, hqhi.le, ?_⟩
    have := (le_max_right 0 (x - δ)).trans_lt hqlo
    linarith

theorem finite_rational_l1_approximation {α : Type u} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ q : α → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) ∧ (∑ i, q i = 1) ∧
      ∑ i, |(q i : ℝ) - w i| < ε := by
  classical
  let c : ℝ := Fintype.card α
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (4 * c)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hbelow : ∀ i, ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ w i ∧ w i - q < δ :=
    fun i => rational_below (hw i) hδ
  choose v hv using hbelow
  let a : α := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let S : ℚ := ∑ i, v i
  have hSreal : (S : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (S : ℝ) = ∑ i, (v i : ℝ) := by simp [S]
      _ ≤ ∑ i, w i := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (hv i).2.1
      _ = 1 := hsum
  have hS : S ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hSreal
  let q : α → ℚ := fun i => v i + if i = a then 1 - S else 0
  have hqnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i := by
    intro i
    have hvnonneg : 0 ≤ v i := by exact_mod_cast (hv i).1
    dsimp [q]
    split_ifs <;> linarith
  have hqsum : ∑ i, q i = 1 := by
    simp [q, Finset.sum_add_distrib, S]
  let R : ℝ := 1 - S
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := sub_nonneg.mpr hSreal
  have hRsum : R = ∑ i, (w i - (v i : ℝ)) := by
    simp [R, S, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum]
  have hpoint : ∀ i, |(q i : ℝ) - w i| ≤
      (w i - (v i : ℝ)) + if i = a then R else 0 := by
    intro i
    have hvle : (v i : ℝ) - w i ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (hv i).2.1
    by_cases hi : i = a
    · have hdiff : (q i : ℝ) - w i = (v i : ℝ) - w i + R := by
        simp [q, hi, R]
        ring
      rw [hdiff]
      calc
        _ ≤ |(v i : ℝ) - w i| + |R| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = (w i - (v i : ℝ)) + if i = a then R else 0 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos hvle, abs_of_nonneg hR]
          simp only [hi, ite_true]
          ring
    · simp [q, hi, abs_of_nonpos hvle]
  have herrors : ∑ i, (w i - (v i : ℝ)) ≤ c * δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : α, δ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (hv i).2.2.le
      _ = c * δ := by simp [c]
  have hbudget : 2 * c * δ < ε := by
    have heq : 2 * c * δ = ε / 2 := by
      dsimp [δ]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq]
    linarith
  refine ⟨q, hqnonneg, hqsum, ?_⟩
  calc
    ∑ i, |(q i : ℝ) - w i| ≤
        ∑ i, ((w i - (v i : ℝ)) + if i = a then R else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hpoint i
    _ = (∑ i, (w i - (v i : ℝ))) + R := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = 2 * (∑ i, (w i - (v i : ℝ))) := by rw [hRsum]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (c * δ) := by gcongr
    _ < ε := by nlinarith [hbudget]

theorem rationalize_uniformly {α : Type u} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    {ξ η : ℝ} (hmargin : ξ < η) :
    ∃ q : α → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) ∧ (∑ i, q i = 1) ∧
      ∀ b : α → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i ∧ b i ≤ 1) →
        (∑ i, w i * b i) ≤ ξ → (∑ i, (q i : ℝ) * b i) < η := by
  obtain ⟨q, hqnonneg, hqsum, hdist⟩ :=
    finite_rational_l1_approximation w hw hsum (sub_pos.mpr hmargin)
  refine ⟨q, hqnonneg, hqsum, ?_⟩
  intro b hb hwb
  have heq : (∑ i, (q i : ℝ) * b i) - (∑ i, w i * b i) =
      ∑ i, (((q i : ℝ) - w i) * b i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hdiff : |(∑ i, (q i : ℝ) * b i) - (∑ i, w i * b i)| < η - ξ := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |((q i : ℝ) - w i) * b i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |(q i : ℝ) - w i| := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hb i).1]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (hb i).2
      _ < η - ξ := hdist
  have hupper := (abs_lt.mp hdiff).2
  linarith

end AlignmentRationalization

claims.natural_statement: For fixed finite r,s,d, lengths and equality relations on at most d occupied slots per index set form a finite collection of patterns, independent of the label universe, and restriction preserves separation and badness.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset
open scoped Classical

namespace AlignmentFinitePatterns

universe u v w

def AlignedFamily {ι : Type u} {M : Type v} {β : Type w}
    (A : ι → Finset M) (T : Finset ι) (C : ι → Finset β)
    (B : Finset β) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : M → β, (∀ x, a x ∈ B) ∧
    ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ x ∈ A i, a x ∈ C i

theorem aligned_image_iff {ι : Type u} {M : Type v} {K : Type*} [DecidableEq K]
    {β : Type w}
    (A : ι → Finset M) (U : Finset M) (φ : M → K)
    (hU : ∀ i, A i ⊆ U) (hinj : Set.InjOn φ U)
    (T : Finset ι) (C : ι → Finset β) {B : Finset β} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    AlignedFamily (fun i => (A i).image φ) T C B ↔ AlignedFamily A T C B := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, haB, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a ∘ φ, fun x => haB (φ x), ?_⟩
    intro i hi x hx
    exact ha i hi (φ x) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem φ hx)
  · rintro ⟨a, haB, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB
    let f : K → β := fun y =>
      if hy : ∃ x, x ∈ U ∧ φ x = y then a hy.choose else b
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y
      dsimp [f]
      split_ifs with hy
      · exact haB hy.choose
      · exact hb
    · intro i hi y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      have he : ∃ z, z ∈ U ∧ φ z = y := ⟨x, hU i hx, hxy⟩
      have hrepr : he.choose = x :=
        hinj he.choose_spec.1 (hU i hx) (he.choose_spec.2.trans hxy.symm)
      dsimp [f]
      rw [dif_pos he, hrepr]
      exact ha i hi x hx

theorem finite_relabeling {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {M : Type v}
    (A : ι → Finset M) (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, (A i).card ≤ d) :
    ∃ φ : M → Fin (d * Fintype.card ι + 1),
      (∀ i, ((A i).image φ).card = (A i).card) ∧
      (∀ i j, Disjoint ((A i).image φ) ((A j).image φ) ↔ Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧
      (∀ (β : Type w) (T : Finset ι) (C : ι → Finset β)
        (B : Finset β), B.Nonempty →
        (AlignedFamily (fun i => (A i).image φ) T C B ↔ AlignedFamily A T C B)) ∧
      (∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ A i, ∀ y ∈ A j, φ x = φ y ↔ x = y) := by
  let U : Finset M := Finset.univ.biUnion A
  have hU : ∀ i, A i ⊆ U := by
    intro i x hx
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx⟩
  have hcard : U.card ≤ d * Fintype.card ι := by
    calc
      U.card ≤ ∑ i, (A i).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, d := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hd i
      _ = d * Fintype.card ι := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hbound : Fintype.card ↥U ≤ d * Fintype.card ι + 1 := by
    simpa using hcard.trans (Nat.le_succ (d * Fintype.card ι))
  let e : ↥U → Fin (d * Fintype.card ι + 1) := fun x =>
    ⟨(Fintype.equivFin ↥U x).val, ((Fintype.equivFin ↥U x).isLt).trans_le hbound⟩
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply (Fintype.equivFin ↥U).injective
    apply Fin.ext
    have hval : (e x).val = (e y).val := congrArg Fin.val hxy
    exact hval
  let φ : M → Fin (d * Fintype.card ι + 1) := fun x =>
    if hx : x ∈ U then e ⟨x, hx⟩ else ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φ U := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    change x ∈ U at hx
    change y ∈ U at hy
    have heq : e ⟨x, hx⟩ = e ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
      simpa only [φ, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy] using hxy
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (he heq)
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact Finset.card_image_of_injOn (hinj.mono (hU i))
  · intro i j
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp h
        (Finset.mem_image_of_mem φ hx) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem φ hy)
    · intro h
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro z hz hz'
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz'
      have hxy : x = y := hinj (hU i hx) (hU j hy) (hxz.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp h hx (hxy ▸ hy)
  · intro β T C B hB
    exact aligned_image_iff A U φ hU hinj T C hB
  · intro i j x hx y hy
    exact ⟨hinj (hU i hx) (hU j hy), fun h => congrArg φ h⟩

theorem representative_space_finite (ι : Type u) [Finite ι] (k : ℕ) :
    Finite (ι → Finset (Fin k)) := by infer_instance

end AlignmentFinitePatterns

claims.natural_statement: If for some xi>0 no finite real sampler works uniformly over allowed patterns, then for every r>=s there is a probability law on allowed patterns such that every s-subset is bad with probability at least xi.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset

namespace AlignmentMinimax

universe u v

noncomputable def payoff {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    (b : P → Q → ℝ) (x : P → ℝ) (y : Q → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p, x p * ∑ q, y q * b p q

noncomputable def leftLinear {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    (b : P → Q → ℝ) (y : Q → ℝ) : (P → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun x := payoff b x y
  map_add' x z := by simp [payoff, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c x := by
    simp [payoff, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

noncomputable def rightLinear {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    (b : P → Q → ℝ) (x : P → ℝ) : (Q → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun y := payoff b x y
  map_add' y z := by
    simp [payoff, add_mul, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c y := by
    simp [payoff, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
      mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

theorem payoff_single_right {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    [DecidableEq Q] (b : P → Q → ℝ) (x : P → ℝ) (q : Q) :
    payoff b x (Pi.single q 1) = ∑ p, x p * b p q := by
  simp [payoff, Pi.single_apply]

theorem payoff_single_left {P : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    [DecidableEq P] (b : P → Q → ℝ) (p : P) (y : Q → ℝ) :
    payoff b (Pi.single p 1) y = ∑ q, y q * b p q := by
  simp [payoff, Pi.single_apply]

theorem randomized_adversary {P : Type u} {Q : Type v}
    [Fintype P] [Fintype Q] [Nonempty P] [Nonempty Q]
    (b : P → Q → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ)
    (hbad : ∀ x ∈ stdSimplex ℝ P, ∃ q, ξ < ∑ p, x p * b p q) :
    ∃ y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ Q, ∀ p, ξ < ∑ q, y q * b p q := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty P›
  obtain ⟨q₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty Q›
  have hX : (stdSimplex ℝ P).Nonempty :=
    ⟨Pi.single p₀ 1, single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ p₀⟩
  have hY : (stdSimplex ℝ Q).Nonempty :=
    ⟨Pi.single q₀ 1, single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ q₀⟩
  have hleft : ∀ y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ Q,
      LowerSemicontinuousOn (fun x : P → ℝ => payoff b x y) (stdSimplex ℝ P) := by
    intro y _
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : P → ℝ => payoff b x y) := by
      unfold payoff
      fun_prop
    exact hc.continuousOn.lowerSemicontinuousOn
  have hright : ∀ x ∈ stdSimplex ℝ P,
      UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun y : Q → ℝ => payoff b x y) (stdSimplex ℝ Q) := by
    intro x _
    have hc : Continuous (fun y : Q → ℝ => payoff b x y) := by
      unfold payoff
      fun_prop
    exact hc.continuousOn.upperSemicontinuousOn
  have hconvex : ∀ y ∈ stdSimplex ℝ Q,
      QuasiconvexOn ℝ (stdSimplex ℝ P) (fun x => payoff b x y) := by
    intro y _
    exact ((leftLinear b y).convexOn (convex_stdSimplex ℝ P)).quasiconvexOn
  have hconcave : ∀ x ∈ stdSimplex ℝ P,
      QuasiconcaveOn ℝ (stdSimplex ℝ Q) (fun y => payoff b x y) := by
    intro x _
    exact ((rightLinear b x).concaveOn (convex_stdSimplex ℝ Q)).quasiconcaveOn
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Sion.exists_isSaddlePointOn
    hX (convex_stdSimplex ℝ P) (isCompact_stdSimplex ℝ P) hleft hconvex
    (convex_stdSimplex ℝ Q) hY (isCompact_stdSimplex ℝ Q) hright hconcave
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hbad x hx
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
  intro p
  have h₁ := hxy x hx (Pi.single q 1) (single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ q)
  have h₂ := hxy (Pi.single p 1) (single_mem_stdSimplex ℝ p) y hy
  rw [payoff_single_right] at h₁
  rw [payoff_single_left] at h₂
  exact hq.trans_le (h₁.trans h₂)

end AlignmentMinimax
